shift_pattern: Morning 7AM-3PM or evening 3PM-11PM, 6 days a week

screening_questions.text: Do you have your own two-wheeler in working condition?
screening_questions.why_it_matters: Own vehicle is mandatory for this role.

screening_questions.text: Do you have a valid two-wheeler driving licence?
screening_questions.why_it_matters: Riding without a licence is not permitted.

screening_questions.text: Which shift suits you better, morning or evening?
screening_questions.why_it_matters: We staff both shifts and need to know availability.

screening_questions.text: How many years have you been riding a two-wheeler regularly?
screening_questions.why_it_matters: Comfort in city traffic reduces early attrition.

screening_questions.text: Do you have an Android smartphone you can use for work?
screening_questions.why_it_matters: The rider app only runs on Android.

facts_the_agent_may_state: The role is delivery rider for Chennai operations covering Adyar, Velachery and T. Nagar.
Pay is Rs 18,000 to Rs 24,000 per month depending on shift and deliveries completed.
A fuel allowance of Rs 2,500 per month is paid separately.
Shifts are morning 7 AM to 3 PM or evening 3 PM to 11 PM, six days a week with one weekly off.
Most deliveries are within 5 km of the assigned zone.
Company t-shirt, delivery bag and accident insurance cover are provided.
There is a Rs 1,000 joining bonus after 50 completed deliveries.
Freshers are welcome; prior delivery experience is not required.
An own two-wheeler, a valid licence and an Android smartphone are required.
